name: National Woodwork Mfg.
old_description: For more than 30 years we have provided quality products to commercial and residential clients.  Our cabinetry and millwork add value to our clients' projects at competitive prices.  we also strive to meet all delivery schedules.
about:
National Woodwork Mfg. was established in 1985 in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, as a privately held family business. The company began with a focus on custom cabinetry and architectural millwork, serving commercial, institutional, and residential clients across the Mid-Atlantic region.

The shop produces custom architectural millwork, commercial casework, cabinetry, wall panel systems, reception desks, fixtures, and specialty wood products. Capabilities include CNC machining, edge banding, and precision cutting on equipment such as a Tectra 6120 classic horizontal beam saw and an Atlas Copco compressor. The facility at 950 Jennings Street houses both traditional woodworking craftsmanship and modern computerized equipment.

The company serves architects, contractors, designers, and business owners in sectors including healthcare, education, hospitality, retail, government, and commercial office space. Projects have been delivered throughout Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, Virginia, Washington, D.C., and surrounding areas, with notable installations in schools, libraries, museums, and hotels.

National Woodwork Mfg. emphasizes skilled craftsmanship combined with continuous equipment upgrades to maintain quality, competitive pricing, and timely delivery. The firm has earned the AWI Award of Excellence and was named one of the top 100 fastest-growing millwork companies in North America for eight consecutive years by Wood & Wood Products magazine.
